D: Good morning. Can you confirm your name for me?
P: Sarah Peeters. I was born on 2 March 1984.
D: Thank you. And you live in Leuven?
P: Yes, on Naamsestraat, near the university.
D: What brings you in today?
P: I've had a rash on my cheeks for about six weeks. It's a rose colour, and it gets worse in the sun. My knuckles ache in the morning too.
D: How long does the stiffness last?
P: An hour or more. I can't open a jar before ten.
D: Any mouth ulcers or hair loss?
P: Some hair in the shower drain, yes. My sister Rose noticed a thin patch at the back.
D: Who is your GP?
P: Dr Janssens at the practice on Bondgenotenlaan. She sent bloods to UZ Leuven last week.
D: And the best number to reach you?
P: 0478 61 23 45, or e-mail me at sarah.peeters84@outlook.com.
